company_chosen: ECON Healthcare Group (ECON Healthcare (Asia) Pte. Ltd.), Singapore
why_chosen: Mid-size private eldercare operator (nursing homes, home care, day care) and a large employer of nurses and allied health, plausible for a Singapore job seeker; not a public cluster or global pharma. Chosen before research; ownership status unknown at the time.

identity.summary: Operating since 1987 (founder Ong Chu Poh); ECON Healthcare (Asia) Pte. Ltd. UEN 200400965N; holding company incorporated 2004, Catalist-listed 2021, delisted July 2025 after TPG takeover.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced the official site, EQT, MyCareersFuture, regulator and news pages; extraction read EQT, Straits Times and Entrepreneur cleanly.
identity.what_was_missing: Official about page extracted as navigation text only; no ACRA record.

business_and_headcount.summary: Nursing homes, home care, day care, rehab, TCM. 8 to 10 sites depending on source and date; now part of One Aged Care (15 homes, 2,400+ beds, 50+ ambulances). Headcount not found.
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Located and extracted the locations and news pages.

financial_performance.summary: TPG take-private at 33c/share (about S$88m, 20% premium). One snippet reports S$6.3m earnings up 8% with a confusing FY label. Growth via acquisitions.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Found deal coverage and filings listings quickly.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Financial statements; the sginvestors page was behind a JavaScript wall and SGX/PDF filings were not opened.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: No layoffs found for ECON or One Aged Care; restructuring was delisting, a new holding platform and a CEO change. Absence of evidence only.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Targeted search returned only generic layoff coverage, so nothing ECON-specific in top results.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Cannot prove a negative; layoffsg tracker not extracted.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Mixed: collaborative colleagues and learning vs overtime, night duty, admin load, slow decisions; Indeed 3.4 from 5 reviews with management 2.3; one strongly negative 2021 healthcare assistant review.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Extracted Jobstreet and Indeed review pages as readable text.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Glassdoor extraction failed; very small samples; no turnover data.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Staff nurse estimates conflict (S$1,800 to S$3,575 per month across Glassdoor and Indeed snippets). Benefits only vaguely 'incentives, awards, trips'. Allied health not found.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Search snippets exposed salary figures from the salary pages.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Pages not opened (extract budget); no reliable band or benefits list.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Only counts of Glassdoor interview reviews (3 questions, 4 to 5 reviews); no process detail or red flags.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Content of interview reviews (extraction budget used up).

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No complaints, fines, MOH or court matters about ECON found; official domains and the MyCareersFuture listing exist. Absence is not proof.
red_flags_and_scams.how_openserp_helped: Search returned regulator and court portals, showing no ECON-specific hits.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: No searchable inspection or licensing record for ECON; complaint search returned generic pages.

recent_news.summary: TPG formed One Aged Care (Mar 2026), acquired Active Global (announced Oct 2026), Jurong East home opening in 2026.
recent_news.how_openserp_helped: Fresh, dated news results appeared within days of publication.

misleading_or_wrong_results: A funding query returned irrelevant generic results (IRAS, NIH); needs company-specific keywords
Indeed review page included reviews from unrelated roles and countries
sginvestors snippet FY label (FY2024 ended Mar 31, 2024) looks inconsistent
Glassdoor salary snippets conflict (S$1,800 vs S$3,575)
Two Bing searches timed out with HTTP 504

verdict.reasoning: OpenSERP quickly established identity, ownership, recent news and a mixed sentiment picture with citable URLs. Two Bing searches timed out, Glassdoor extraction failed, some pages were walled, and the 10-extract budget meant salary and interview data came from snippets only. Good for due diligence on facts and news; weak for pay, culture depth and hiring practice.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Talk to current or former ECON nurses
Written offer with grade, shift pattern, overtime and night allowances
Which entity employs you after the One Aged Care integration
Licensing status and any inspection findings
Open vacancies and role scope for allied health
